issue: The earlier pit canopy used the full 401.6 m by 118.8 m compound bounding frame. It covered 19,587 m², including 15,370 m² outside the actual articulated pit footprint. It did not cross the racing road; the defect was unsupported courtyard roofing.

source_support.observation: Layered side-mounted control roofs sit over the actual garage wings. The separate main grandstand canopy remains on the left, with open sky between.

correction: Retain two groups and four layered fins. Register each group to its actual mapped garage wing at native 528 m and 804 m. Restrict overhang to at most 6 m toward the pit apron. Keep support columns inside those wings and close each slab with a downward soffit and edge fascia. Remove the roof-contaminated ground only inside the mapped pit footprint.
foundation: Use the low mapped building-foot ground already used by its facade, not the compound centroid DSM roof. Its value depends on the current joined road profile. The lowest fin clears the existing 11 m office roof.

estimates.note: Locations are mapped wing registrations. Fine heights, spacing and overhang are original visual estimates.

separate_findings.whole_road_roof_claim: Both original and corrected structures have zero racing-road XY overlap. Perspective alone was not an over-track roof defect.
separate_findings.main_stand: The mapped left stand canopy already fits its footprint and matches the supplied reference. It is preserved.
separate_findings.width_and_elevation: Registered width and local FIA climb corrections are recorded separately. Root must synchronize and rebuild native surfaces before the final runtime review.
